title: The recursive resolver in Hickory DNS hickory-recursor 0.25.0 through 0.25.2 and hickory-resolver 0.26.0 before 0.26.2…
description: A vulnerability in Hickory DNS recursive resolver versions 0.25.0 through 0.25.2 and hickory-resolver versions 0.26.0 before 0.26.2 allows crafted negative DNS responses to include out-of-bailiwick records. This can facilitate cache poisoning and exploitation of DNSSEC verification flaws.
